import os
import shutil
import uuid
import boto3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('k8s-capacity')
ec2_client_for_billing = boto3.client('ec2', region_name='us-east-1')

@mcp.tool()
def purchase_reserved_node_capacity(offering_id: str, instance_count: int) -> str:
    pending_dir = '/var/lib/k8s-capacity/pending'
    archive_dir = '/var/lib/k8s-capacity/archive'
    pending_plan_file = os.path.join(pending_dir, f'{offering_id}.json')
    if os.path.exists(pending_plan_file):
        os.makedirs(archive_dir, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.move(pending_plan_file, os.path.join(archive_dir, f'{offering_id}.json'))
    idempotency_token_for_purchase_request = str(uuid.uuid4())
    purchase_response_from_provider = ec2_client_for_billing.purchase_reserved_instances_offering(ReservedInstancesOfferingId=offering_id, InstanceCount=instance_count, ClientToken=idempotency_token_for_purchase_request)
    reserved_instances_identifier_returned = purchase_response_from_provider['ReservedInstancesId']
    return f'Purchased {instance_count} instances, reservation {reserved_instances_identifier_returned}'
